name: noise
desc: Show many pieces of content at once.
prompt: /effects noise from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my covers folder.

name: lineup
desc: Arrange numbered tiles above the speaker.
prompt: /effects lineup from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Hook|Story|Offer.

name: locked-on
desc: Track the face with brackets and a following zoom.
prompt: /effects locked-on from 3 to 6 seconds. Use zoom 1.35.

name: orbit
desc: Move reel cards around the speaker with depth.
prompt: /effects orbit from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my covers folder.

name: lean-in
desc: Make a fast punch in to the speaker.
prompt: /effects lean-in from 3 to 6 seconds. Use zoom 1.45.

name: backdrop-word
desc: Place a large word behind the speaker.
prompt: /effects backdrop-word from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATE.

name: spotlight
desc: Dim the room while keeping the person bright.
prompt: /effects spotlight from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text FOCUS.

name: the-bill
desc: Print a receipt of instructions above the head.
prompt: /effects the-bill from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Plan|Film|Edit|Post.

name: moody
desc: Apply a darker cinematic colour treatment.
prompt: /effects moody from 3 to 6 seconds. Use grade moody.

name: swipe
desc: Sweep a divider between original and graded views.
prompt: /effects swipe from 3 to 6 seconds. Use grade warm.

name: todo
desc: Tick a small list beside the speaker.
prompt: /effects todo from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Plan|Film|Post.

name: comment-box
desc: Type and post a word in a comment interface.
prompt: /effects comment-box from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text GUIDE.

name: tap
desc: Turn a Follow button into Following.
prompt: /effects tap from 3 to 6 seconds. Flip at 4 seconds.

name: pause-point
desc: Freeze the image and draw an arrow to the person.
prompt: /effects pause-point from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Watch this.

name: uninstall
desc: Glitch the image around an uninstall interface.
prompt: /effects uninstall from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Old workflow.

name: reel-frame
desc: Shrink the video into a social reel card.
prompt: /effects reel-frame from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text @yourhandle.

name: shortcut-rain
desc: Drop keyboard keys behind the person.
prompt: /effects shortcut-rain from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CMD|K|SHIFT.

name: reject-stamp
desc: Slam a large rejection stamp onto the image.
prompt: /effects reject-stamp from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text NOPE.

name: countdown-flip
desc: Show a mechanical countdown above the head.
prompt: /effects countdown-flip from 3 to 6 seconds. Count down from 3.

name: rabbit-hole
desc: Repeat the image into a receding tunnel.
prompt: /effects rabbit-hole from 3 to 6 seconds. Use speed 1.

name: cover-star
desc: Build a magazine cover around the speaker.
prompt: /effects cover-star from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATOR.

name: scribble
desc: Draw marker loops and doodles around the person.
prompt: /effects scribble from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Me.

name: glass-widgets
desc: Surround the head with translucent stat widgets.
prompt: /effects glass-widgets from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text 197K and name Creator.

name: red-collage
desc: Combine a monochrome subject with red type.
prompt: /effects red-collage from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text EDIT and lines One clip|Three ideas|Ready.

name: split-headline
desc: Slide a headline into the top half of the image.
prompt: /effects split-headline from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text My new|workflow and hl new.

name: pastel-word
desc: Add a lavender setting and a profile follow card.
prompt: /effects pastel-word from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATE and handle @you.

name: check-pills
desc: Click blue pills over a grid and pinned content.
prompt: /effects check-pills from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Hooks|Cuts|Captions.

name: timeline
desc: Add a red film treatment and an editing timeline.
prompt: /effects timeline from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text AUTO EDIT.

name: headline-box
desc: Punch in with a clean two line headline.
prompt: /effects headline-box from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text One clip|Three ideas.

name: profile-wall
desc: Fill the background with reels and a rising total.
prompt: /effects profile-wall from 3 to 6 seconds. Use count 197000 and label views.

name: tier-list
desc: Animate an item into the top row of a tier list.
prompt: /effects tier-list from 3 to 6 seconds. Use item My pick.

name: broll-split
desc: Put supporting imagery above the speaker.
prompt: /effects broll-split from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my images folder and text New tool.

name: phone-fan
desc: Spread reel cards in a fan under a headline.
prompt: /effects phone-fan from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text My best|reels and my covers folder.

name: dot-reveal
desc: Resolve glowing dots into the full image.
prompt: /effects dot-reveal from 3 to 6 seconds. Use color FFD60A.

name: headline-wall
desc: Stack headlines behind the person and show a total.
prompt: /effects headline-wall from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text First post::Launch|Next post::Week 2 and total 197K.

name: checklist
desc: Animate a dark task panel with progress and ticks.
prompt: /effects checklist from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Plan::done|Film::done|Post::next.

name: liquid-glass-graph
desc: Raise a line graph and count up a metric.
prompt: /effects liquid-glass-graph from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Views, from 0, to 197K.

name: carousel-spin
desc: Rotate reel cards in a carousel and ease to a stop.
prompt: /effects carousel-spin from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my covers folder.

name: match-cut
desc: Switch page layouts around one fixed word.
prompt: /effects match-cut from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATE.

name: apple-toggles
desc: Turn on settings switches one row at a time.
prompt: /effects apple-toggles from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Hooks|Cuts|Captions.

name: led-sign
desc: Darken the room and type a glowing sign behind you.
prompt: /effects led-sign from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text READY|TO CREATE.

name: slow-push
desc: Slowly move closer as the background softens.
prompt: /effects slow-push from 3 to 6 seconds. Use zoom 1.6.

name: over-the-shoulder-zoom
desc: Move between two corners with glass charts.
prompt: /effects over-the-shoulder-zoom from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Views|Reach and to 197K|672K.

name: messages
desc: Stack soft glass message notifications.
prompt: /effects messages from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Is it ready?|Just posted!.

name: place-in-grid
desc: Shrink the speaker into a grid of nine reel tiles.
prompt: /effects place-in-grid from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my covers folder and real view counts.
options: `images` (folder of your reels or covers), `views` (9 counts with `\|`, the 9th is yours)

name: tape-label
desc: Land a yellow tape label on the chest.
prompt: /effects tape-label from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Start here.

name: select-resize
desc: Select a number and drag it larger.
prompt: /effects select-resize from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text 2X.

name: wave-trim
desc: Animate a waveform with its silent ends collapsing.
prompt: /effects wave-trim from 3 to 6 seconds. Show the waveform animation.

name: huge-strike
desc: Cross out a large serif phrase behind the head.
prompt: /effects huge-strike from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text 8 HOURS.
options: `text`, `at` (seconds into the effect when the strike lands, default 0.6)

name: crayon-write
desc: Write and underline a word with a red crayon.
prompt: /effects crayon-write from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATE.

name: fan-build
desc: Deal reel covers into a fan one card at a time.
prompt: /effects fan-build from 3 to 6 seconds. Use my covers folder and count 13.

name: glitter-spotlight
desc: Add golden rays and sparkles to the spotlight.
prompt: /effects glitter-spotlight from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text SHINE.

name: cover-star-editorial
desc: Use a warm serif magazine cover treatment.
prompt: /effects cover-star from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text CREATOR and look editorial.

name: liquid-glass-graph-bento
desc: Combine a background graph with glass metric tiles.
prompt: /effects liquid-glass-graph from 3 to 6 seconds. Use text Views, to 197K and look bento.
